record.question: The deflection angle may have any value between —
record.explanation: A survey deflection angle is measured right or left from the prolongation of the previous course to the next course. Its ordinary non-reflex magnitude lies between0° and180° (the handbook states less than180°); the fourth range is the appropriate offered one. Reference: https://directives.nrcs.usda.gov/sites/default/files2/1712930814/33252.pdf. Original printed source and ordered choices independently reviewed. Verified worked solution, unofficial; no matching examiner key is asserted.
